```{r}
library(tidyverse)
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

# Data for major group "Calanoids" in the lvl1 data (both main and excluded)
load("data/calanoid_trait_data.RData")
```

# Size distribution of Arctic Calanus spp
```{r}

calanus.size <- calanoid.level1.traitdata %>% 
  filter(genus %in% c("Calanus")) %>% 
  filter(scientificName %in% c("Calanus finmarchicus",
                               "Calanus glacialis",
                               "Calanus hyperboreus")) %>% 
  filter(traitName %in% c("bodyLength")) %>%  
  # Assume all non prosome length is body length
  mutate(sizeType = if_else(sizeType != "prosome length",
                                  "body length", "prosome length")) %>%
  mutate(sizeType = if_else(is.na(sizeType),
                                  "body length", sizeType)) %>%
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue)) %>% 
  mutate(lifeStage = factor(lifeStage,
                            levels = c("C1","C2","C3","C4","C5",
                                       "adult","female","male"))) %>% 
  mutate(sizeType = factor(sizeType,
                           levels = c("prosome length", 
                                      "body length")))


ggplot(calanus.size,
       aes(y = traitValue, x = scientificName,
           color = lifeStage, shape = sizeType)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21:24)) +
  facet_wrap(~sizeType)

ggplot(calanus.size,
         aes(x = traitValue, y = scientificName,
             color = scientificName))+
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) 

# Size at C4
calanus.size %>% 
  group_by(scientificName, lifeStage) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(traitValue),
            sd = sd(traitValue),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")

```



Visualize the trait distributions of carbon content, lipid content, size (length and weight), and respiration rates (active)
```{r}
resp <- calanoid.level1.traitdata %>% 
  filter(majorgroup == "Calanoid") %>% 
  filter(traitName %in% c("respirationRate_WSC_15C", 
                          "respirationRate_WSDW_15C",
                          "respirationRate_15C")) %>% 
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue)) %>% 
  filter(genus == "Calanus") %>% 
  filter(verbatimTemperature <= 2)

Calanus.respiration <- resp %>% 
  filter(genus == "Calanus") %>% 
  group_by(traitName, scientificName) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(traitValue),
            sd = sd(traitValue),
            n = n())
```

# Get literature values of traits
- Body length
- carbon weight
- LipidPDW (note not carbon weight so likely higher?)
- Respiration rate? But have to convert to 0 degC, and from ul O2/h to ugC/day
```{r}
calanus.length <- calanoid.level1.traitdata %>% 
  filter(traitName == "bodyLength") %>%
  filter(scientificName %in% c("Calanus glacialis", "Calanus hyperboreus")) %>% 
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue)) %>% 
  filter(lifeStage %in% c("C3","C4","C5","male","female","adult"))


calanus.cweight <- calanoid.level1.traitdata %>% 
  filter(traitName == "carbonWeight") %>%
  filter(genus == "Calanus") %>% 
  filter(scientificName %in% c("Calanus glacialis", "Calanus hyperboreus")) %>%
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue)) 

# TODO Not exactly based on carbon like in this study
calanus.lipid <- calanoid.level1.traitdata %>% 
  filter(traitName == "lipidPDW") %>%
  filter(genus == "Calanus") %>% 
  # filter(scientificName %in% c("Calanus glacialis", "Calanus hyperboreus")) %>%
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue)) 

# The general calanoid carbon percent biovolume / dry weight
calanoids.cperc <- calanoid.level1.traitdata %>% 
  filter(traitName %in% c("carbonPWW","carbonPDW","dryWeightPWW",
                          "lipidPWW","lipidPDW")) %>% 
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue))

# rough average of all traits (not controlled by species)... the 0.2 * 0.45 is actually a good estimate
calanoids.cperc %>% 
  group_by(traitName) %>% 
  summarise(nindiv = n(),
            mean = mean(traitValue, na.rm = T),
            sd = sd(traitValue, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop")

# filter carbonPWW to not include large species (Neocalanus, Rhincalanus, Calanus fin/gl/hy ... pac&hel??)
calanoids.cpww <- calanoids.cperc %>% 
  filter(traitName == "carbonPWW") %>% 
  group_by(scientificName) %>% 
  summarise(nindiv = n(),
            mean = mean(traitValue, na.rm = T),
            sd = sd(traitValue, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(-mean)
calanoids.cpww <- calanoids.cpww %>% 
  mutate(scientificName = factor(scientificName,
                                 levels = unique(calanoids.cpww$scientificName))) %>% 
  # exclude pseudocalanus minutus because it seems like an outlier with n = 1
  filter(scientificName != "Pseudocalanus minutus")

# species average
mean(calanoids.cpww$mean)
# species average without large calanus...
notliipidcopes <- mean( (calanoids.cpww %>% 
         filter(scientificName %notin% c("Calanus hyperboreus", "Neocalanus cristatus",
                                         "Calanus pacificus",
                                         "Calanus helgolandicus", "Neocalanus plumchrus",
                                         "Calanus finmarchicus", "Calanus glacialis")))$mean)


ggplot(calanoids.cpww, aes(y = scientificName, x = mean)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = mean - sd, xmax = mean + sd)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 9, color = "pink") + # 20% x 45%
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(calanoids.cpww$mean), color = "red") + # species average
  geom_vline(xintercept = notliipidcopes, color = "blue") +
  xlab("Carbon % Wet Weight") +
  ylab("Calanoid copepods")
  
```

```{r}
# load("data/Cavallo2020_lipid_data_temp.RData")

#                                   "total lipid (µg/individual)")) %>% 
#   select(-verbatimTraitUnit) %>% 
#   pivot_wider(names_from = verbatimTraitName,
#               values_from = verbatimTraitValue)


df.cav <- readxl::read_xlsx("C:/Users/patri/OneDrive - Université Laval/New_Trait_Data_For_Database/Cavallo Peck Lipids/ICES_Supplementary_Tables_ed.xlsx",
                             sheet = "Supp. Table 1", skip = 1) %>% 
  
  filter(Species %in% c("Calanus hyperboreus", "Calanus glacialis", 
                               "Calanus finmarchicus")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(`WE (% TL)`)) %>% 
  mutate(`WE (% TL)` = as.numeric(`WE (% TL)`)) %>% 
  
  # Convert WE ug to carbon, WE%DW
  rename(TL_ug =  `TL (µg/individual)`) %>% 
  mutate(WE_ug = TL_ug * (`WE (% TL)` / 100)) %>% 
  mutate(WE_perc_DW = `WE (% TL)`/100 * `TL (% DW)` /100) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(WE_ug)) %>% 
  
  relocate(Species, Stage, Sex, TL_ug, WE_ug, WE_perc_DW)

```

## Organizing the Durazzano and Titocci 2026 dataset
```{r}
# The raw data table
df.dur <- read.csv("C:/Users/patri/OneDrive - Université Laval/New_Trait_Data_For_Database/Durazzano_holoplankton_Arctic_traits/Dataset_marine_holoplankton_Arctic.csv", sep = ";") %>% 
  filter(acceptedNameUsage %in% c("Calanus hyperboreus", "Calanus glacialis", 
                               "Calanus finmarchicus")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(waxEstersContent)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(lipidContent)) %>% 
  filter(waxEstersContent_bibliographicCitation != "https://doi.org/10.1093/icesjms/fsaa070") %>% 
  
# TODO calculate WE in mg from WE%TL , TL%DW, and DW  
  mutate(TL_ug = dryWeight * (lipidContent / 100) / 1000) %>% 
  mutate(WE_ug = TL_ug * (waxEstersContent / 100)) %>% 
  mutate(WE_perc_DW = (waxEstersContent / 100) * (lipidContent / 100)) %>% 
  
  relocate(acceptedNameUsage, lifeStage, TL_ug, WE_ug, WE_perc_DW)
  
# TODO Convert content in % to carbon weight

```


## Estimate lipid mass from LPDW 
```{r}
# TODO Add the Cavallo and Peck data table
# Currently all based on Hebert et al. 2016
calanus.lipids <- calanoid.level1.traitdata %>% 
  filter(traitName == "lipidPDW") %>% 
  filter(sizeAssocValue >= 0) %>% 
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue)) %>% 
  mutate(lipidMass = (traitValue/100) * sizeAssocValue) %>% 
  mutate(lipidMass_mgC = lipidMass * lambda) %>% 
  select(scientificName, lifeStage, lipidMass, lipidMass_mgC,
         lipidPDW = traitValue, dryWeight = sizeAssocValue,
         primaryReference, secondaryReference) %>% 
  filter(scientificName %in% c("Calanus hyperboreus", "Calanus glacialis", 
                               "Calanus finmarchicus")) %>% 
  mutate(scientificName = str_replace(scientificName, "Calanus", "C.")) %>% 
  mutate(scientificName = paste(scientificName, "F"))

# TODO add the cavallo and Durazzano data


calanus.size.edited <- calanus.size %>% 
         mutate(lifeStage = if_else(lifeStage %in% c("male","female"),
                                    "adult",lifeStage)) %>% 
         mutate(lifeStage = if_else(lifeStage == "C5",
                                    "CV",lifeStage)) %>% 
         mutate(lifeStage = if_else(lifeStage == "C4",
                                    "CIV",lifeStage)) %>% 
         filter(lifeStage %notin% c("C1","C2","C3")) %>% 
         mutate(scientificNameStage = paste(scientificName, lifeStage)) %>% 
         mutate(scientificNameStage = str_replace(scientificNameStage,
                                                  "Calanus", "C.")) %>% 
         mutate(scientificNameStage = 
                  factor(scientificNameStage,
                         levels = c("C. hyperboreus adult",
                                    "C. glacialis adult",
                                    "C. glacialis CV", "C. glacialis CIV",
                                    "C. finmarchicus adult",
                                    "C. finmarchicus CV", "C. finmarchicus CIV")))

ggplot(calanus.size.edited,
       aes(x = traitValue, y = scientificNameStage,
           color = scientificName))+
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point()+
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        # axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) 

save(file = "data/temporary_trait_database_subset_20260127.RData",
     calanus.size.edited, calanus.lipids)

```
